title: Smotrich: Israel Demolishes 35 Palestinian Structures to Clear Roads to New West Bank Settlements
detail: Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich announced that Israeli forces demolished 35 Palestinian structures on Wednesday, September 9, 2026 — including commercial facilities, residences, plant nurseries and greenhouses — in the northern West Bank, saying the buildings were 'illegally built' and threatened access roads leading to newly established Israeli settlements. The Civil Administration, which Smotrich oversees as the minister with delegated authority over West Bank civilian affairs, carried out the removals. Smotrich framed the action as enforcement against unauthorized Palestinian construction ahead of the October 27, 2026 Israeli election, while criticizing opposition parties. No specific village names, displacement figures, or Palestinian casualties were reported in available coverage.

media.caption: File photo: an Israeli bulldozer operates near the Migdalim settlement in the West Bank, September 6, 2026 — illustrative of settlement-road construction; not the specific September 9 demolition site

confidenceReason: Reported by a single Tier 2 outlet (Haaretz) attributing the account directly to Smotrich's own statement; no independent Palestinian or human-rights-group confirmation of the count or location was available at time of writing.

title: IDF/Shin Bet Kill Hamas Operative Farah Hamed in Gaza City Drone Strike Over 2003 Killing of MK's Husband
detail: Israeli security forces killed Farah Hamed, described by Israel as a senior Hamas military-wing operative, in a drone strike on a motorcycle on al-Rashid Street in Gaza City's Sheikh Ejleen (Sheikh Ijlin) neighborhood on Wednesday, September 9, 2026. The operation was carried out jointly by the Israel Police's specialized Gideonim unit (Unit 33), the Shin Bet and the IDF. Israel said Hamed belonged to the 'Silwad cell' active during the Second Intifada and was responsible for an October 2003 shooting attack at Ein Yabrud that killed three soldiers, including Shalom Har-Melech, husband of current Otzma Yehudit MK Limor Son Har-Melech. Hamed was captured and later released to Gaza in the 2011 Shalit prisoner-exchange deal; Israel said he subsequently continued in Hamas's military wing, recruiting and directing operatives for attacks in the West Bank. No Palestinian casualty figures beyond Hamed were confirmed by Israeli sources.
